0.comment: Halfdan: Dainsleif and the last order
0.content:
On the day of the cataclysm, Dainsleif as the Twilight Sword told Halfdan to inform all Black Serpent Knights to protect the people of Khaenri'ah at all costs, and then rushed back to the palace. In the Chasm, five hundred years later, he recognised Halfdan as a young Royal Guard elite when the knight signalled the others to stand down. At the end, Halfdan's soul apologised for failing him; Dainsleif said he had done his duty faithfully for five hundred years and that he was proud of them all.

Dainsleif confirmed that Khaenri'ah 'didn't fall' only to ease Halfdan's passing; afterwards he quietly noted there was no need to revive the homeland.

1.comment: Halfdan: The Chasm hilichurls and the water pool
1.content: Hilichurls gathered in the Chasm's underground ruins to live out the end of their lives, apparently because the area weakens the curse. Black Serpent Knights guarded them. The Abyss Order had installed an amplification device at the pool, intended to remove the curse; Dainsleif judged it futile, since the curse is reality-changing, and said it would only prolong their suffering. Halfdan stopped the device at the cost of his life.

2.content: Once Dainsleif's royal guards, the knights were cursed after the cataclysm into Shadowy Husks that lost their minds. They still obey their final orders, which is why they defended the hilichurls in the Chasm. Halfdan is the only one shown to retain recognition.
